neighbours.label: Demons as a race or faction in fantasy or anime narrative (humans and demons at war, the king of the demons, the Demon Lord's army), not the idiom of personal demons and not other fantasy races such as dragons, elves or vampires
fire: For three centuries the border fortress had held back the armies of the demons.
In the second season the demons finally break the seal and pour into the human realm.

Legend says the sword was forged to slay the demons that once ruled the valley.
Our guild takes contracts to hunt demons in the mountains north of the capital.

After the war, humans and demons signed an uneasy truce at the river crossing.
The Demon King's generals gathered in the throne room to plan the invasion.

predictions: Fantasy sentences in which demons are a people or army reach 0.3-0.8 on ' demons'/' demon' (or on the word after 'Demon' in a title).
